speedrunSeason2.description: Independent settings for E1N1 through E9N9. Initial spawn, Invaders, scoring, manual cleanup and timed respawn use this root. Deposit, power bank, claimController and ruin switches remain global under speedrun.

invaders.description: Whether periodic Invader generation runs in the season-2 block. Does not remove existing Invaders or disable Source Keepers or manual Invader requests.

respawnCleanup.description: Whether season-2 respawn clears artificial buildings and construction sites in its block. Completed Extractors in E4N4 through E6N6 are preserved. Player respawn itself remains global.

raceBrackets.description: Tick offsets after a successful season-2 landing at which results are captured. An empty list disables scoring.

respawnAfter.description: Run duration in ticks before automatic respawn. Zero or less disables automatic respawn.
